restoration_note: Teaching describes the four simultaneous works of the Third Ambassador's revealing — icon of glory, gates of firmaments opened/shut, chosen-out super-light, and indwelling perfection in the elect. Restorations are constrained chiefly by (1) the repeated formula ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲍ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ split across line breaks, (2) the feminine ordinal sequence agreeing with ⲧⲉⲭⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ (ⲧⲧϣⲁⲣⲡ → ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍⲥⲛⲉⲩ → ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ → ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍⲭⲧⲁⲩ), and (3) standard cosmological vocabulary (ⲥⲧⲉⲣⲉⲱⲙⲁ, ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ, ⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ, ⲙⲁⲍⲁⲓⲡⲉ). Editor's {2}=ⲟⲩ corrected to ⲱ since 1942 ends with ⲟⲩ- already (split ⲟⲩ-ⲱⲛⲍ across line). Six gaps left unrestored: {8} has no proposed Coptic and lies inside an already-complete temporal phrase ⲡⲥⲏⲩ ⲉⲧⲙⲙⲉⲩ; {10} (5-ch lacuna ending in -ⲩⲉ) and {15} (8-ch lacuna with scattered traces) are weakly constrained; {13} ends a clause whose closure is not formulaic; {18} preserves only -ⲁⲓ̈ at line start and could fit several reconstructions (ⲡⲁⲓ̈, ⲛⲁⲓ̈, ⲁⲭϯⲛⲁⲓ̈); {19}'s partial trace 'ⲩⲃⲧⲏ' fits no obvious Coptic or Greek-loan verb of becoming/giving toward the soul.

restorations.basis: Completes ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲍ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'manifest forth' — standard formula for the Ambassador's revealing of his icon. Editor proposal confirmed.
Completes ⲍⲱⲃ 'work, deed' — the chapter's titular term ⲡⲭⲧⲁⲩ ⲛⲍⲱⲃ. Editor proposal confirmed.
Section 1942 ends with ⲟⲩ- which begins ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲍ; 1943 begins -ⲛⲍ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ. The split is ⲟⲩ|ⲱⲛⲍ, so {2}=ⲱ. (Editor's 'ⲟⲩ' would duplicate the preserved ⲟⲩ at end of prior line.)
Preserved -ⲁⲣⲡ completes ⲧⲧϣⲁⲣⲡ 'the first' (feminine, agreeing with ⲧⲉⲭⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ). Begins the ordinal enumeration of the Four Works.
ⲍⲛ ⲟⲩ_ ⲛⲉⲁⲩ = 'in an icon of glory' — the first work per the reading is 'the icon manifested in glory'. Lexicon ⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ for 'icon'. Editor proposal confirmed.
Genitive linker before ⲉⲁⲩ 'glory' — ⲟⲩⲍⲓⲕⲱⲛ ⲛ̄ⲉⲁⲩ 'an icon of glory'. Editor confirmed.
ⲛ̄ⲛⲥⲧⲉⲣⲉⲱⲙⲁ 'of the firmaments' — standard cosmological term from lexicon. Preserved ⲛⲥ-...-ⲱ confirms split. Editor confirmed.
Completes ⲥⲧⲉⲣⲉⲱⲙⲁ across the line break. Editor confirmed.
Apparatus offers no Coptic; ⲡⲥⲏⲩ ⲉⲧⲙⲙⲉⲩ 'that time' is already complete around the marker. The element at {8} is not constrained by grammar or formula.
Completes ⲥⲉⲟⲩⲉⲛ 'they are opened' (Lyc form of stative ⲟⲩⲏⲛ). Editor confirmed.

5-char lacuna ending before -ⲩⲉ ⲁⲛ ⲥⲉϣⲧⲉⲙ. No clear Coptic word of that length yields a constrained reading; possibilities (ⲛⲏⲩⲉ, ⲥⲏⲩⲉ, ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲩⲉ) are not strongly fixed by the opening-and-shutting cycle.
Preserved ⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ completes ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ 'the third' (feminine ordinal in the work-sequence). Editor confirmed.
Completes ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'the light'. Confirmed by section 1950 starting with ⲁⲓⲛⲉ (= ⲟⲩ|ⲁⲓⲛⲉ split), showing the Lyc orthography ⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ. (Corrects editor's 'ⲛⲉ' to match the dialect's ⲓⲛⲉ.)
Closes the previous clause about ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲥⲱⲧⲭ 'which were chosen-out' but the closing element is not formulaic and not constrained by traces.

ⲡ-_ ⲉⲧⲙⲙⲉⲩ ⲣⲍⲟⲩⲟ ⲡⲁⲣⲁ ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ = 'that light abounds beyond the (ordinary) light' — the third work per the reading is the chosen-out super-light exceeding natural light. Comparative pattern fixes the noun.
8-char lacuna with only scattered traces ending in -ⲉ. No formulaic closing of the third-work clause is recoverable.
Preserved ⲍⲭⲧⲁⲩ completes ⲧⲧⲙⲁⲍⲭⲧⲁⲩ 'the fourth' (feminine ordinal continuing the sequence). Editor confirmed.
ⲁⲭ-_-ⲛⲍ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ = ⲁⲭⲟⲩⲱⲛⲍ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'he manifested forth' — the standard formula recurring at each work. Editor confirmed.
Only -ⲁⲓ̈ preserved at line start. Could be ⲡⲁⲓ̈ ('this'), ⲛⲁⲓ̈ ('these'), or part of a verb like ⲁⲭϯⲛⲁⲓ̈. The reading ('he becomes a light to the Living Soul') does not uniquely fix the form.

5-char lacuna with partial trace 'ⲩⲃⲧⲏ' attached to ⲁⲭⲍ-. No clear Coptic verb of becoming, giving, or shining-toward-the-soul matches that letter sequence; Greek-loan candidates (ⲍⲩⲡⲏⲣⲉⲧⲏⲥ etc.) are too long and don't fit ⲩⲃⲧⲏ.
ⲧⲉⲧⲁⲥⲧⲣⲡ ⲍⲛ̄ ⲟⲩⲭⲱⲕ = 'who shone-forth in a perfection' — standard locative ⲍⲛ̄ ⲟⲩ- before abstract noun. (Editor's 'ⲓⲉ ⲍⲛ̄' includes uncertain trace; the ⲍⲛ̄ is the constrained element.)
Completes the indefinite article ⲟⲩ- before ⲙⲁⲍⲁⲓⲡⲉ 'hidden chamber' (ⲙⲛ̄ ⲟⲩⲙⲁⲍⲁⲓⲡⲉ 'with a hidden chamber'). Editor confirmed.
